# FC · Foundations: embedded systems and C/C++

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

Microcontrollers, MicroPython, interrupts, PIO, real-time concepts, C++ for C# developers, CMake and micro-ROS.

**8 lessons · ≈ 8 h 30 min** · [Course map](../../COURSE_MAP.md) · [Dependency graph](../../curriculum/dependency-graph.md)
